Clare: All-hands in 18. Quick ops note: encoder hardware has a firmware patch pending, fallback plan if encoder drops is to start a software RTMP ingest from the presenter laptop. Leah, you'll own the Q&A handoff.

Leah: On it. Two asks: 1) can we get captions enabled (Zoom captions prefer; fallback to YouTube auto) 2) can the team keep the "raise hand" queue off-stage until we start Q&A?

Tomas: Noted. I'll pre-stage the laptop ingest scene in OBS: `--scene presenter_laptop` and a second scene for `--scene fallback_rtmp`. If encoder dies, I'll switch and post the new RTMP key here.

Priya: +1 captions. Also can someone confirm the recorder location? Need to know where to grab the local file for post-processing.

DevOps Bot: Encoder health: temp 63C | firmware pending 1.2.3. Primary pipeline: hardware-enc -> RTMP -> CDN. Software fallback: OBS (presenter LAP) -> RTMP -> CDN. Local recorder path: /recordings/all-hands/2001234567_local.mp4. Will post failover notice if triggered.

Tomas: If I switch to laptop RTMP, use this command to start OBS stream (copy-paste):

```
obs-cli --start-stream --profile "allhands-fallback" --rtmp "rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2/<key>"
```
I'll post status updates here.
